synopsis: MSHA's Powered Haulage Safety page describes powered-haulage equipment as including shuttle cars, locomotives and front end loaders [f3053]. For US mining in 2025, it reports 13 of 33 deaths (39%) and 426 of 4,792 non-fatal injuries (9%) as caused by powered haulage, showing a larger share of fatalities than non-fatal injuries [f7499, f7500]. Separately, MSHA engineers estimate that providing and wearing adequate seat belts could save three to four miners' lives annually; the supplied facts do not specify how many of those lives fall within powered haulage [f3625].

relations.note: Adds non-fatal injury burden, showing a lower powered-haulage share than for deaths.
